_comment: Ministral 3 3B-only smoke: 2 models x 3 strategies x 2 schema x 4 cases = 48 runs. Exists because the 3B is the only arm the full smoke has never exercised -- it replaced Gemma 3 4B after training finished 2026-08-18 (job 3021705). The other five models already passed submit_eval_smoke.sh, so re-running all 36 conditions to test one new arm wastes hours. Four cases test the CONFIGURATION, not the model: they cannot settle whether fine-tuned beats base. Run with: sbatch submit_eval_smoke.sh --config eval_config.smoke.ministral3b.json
_seed_rationale: shuffle=true because limit takes rows[:N] and the first five testset entries are all order-management.json. Seed 12116 is a coverage device, not a measurement: its first four shuffled entries span four distinct logs INCLUDING bpic2017-ocel2.json, the 2.2 GB log most likely to fail on time or memory, at the lowest gold-execution cost of any seed satisfying that (40k seeds searched). The project seed 3407 covers four logs but misses bpic2017 entirely. Identical to the other smoke configs so the runs are comparable.
